name: The Merchants
desc: Own the convoy. Each leg, raiders and sea monsters together are the threat; crates lost = threat − kills − battery. The crates left after the fourth leg are sold at port for gold, at a price your Speechcraft sets. Mission on floor 14: land the charter cargo past the closed port.

name: The Pirates
desc: Raid the convoy. Each leg, crates seized = battery − (guard − kills). Seized crates pay cargo. Mission on floor 14: board the treasure galleon.

name: The Privateers
desc: Hunt the pirates who took the convoy. Each leg, crates recovered = battery − (pirate crew − kills), out of what the pirate ships still carry. Recovered crates pay cargo. Mission on floor 14: take the pirate king’s flagship.

name: The Navy
desc: Escort the convoy against sea monsters. Each leg, crates lost = monsters − kills − battery. The crates kept after the fourth leg pay cargo. Mission on floor 14: kill the sea beast that closes the lanes.
